Special Offers

One-Way Relocations

  1. Home
  2. Special Offers
  3. Relocation Specials

With 7 locations across Canada, we sometimes need to move vehicles to a specific destination to meet our rental needs. On these occasions, we offer heavily discounted relocation specials.

Please note our cancellation policy regarding Relocation Specials:

Full payment at time of booking and no refund if the reservation is cancelled.

Relocation rates apply to new bookings only.

Please read the FAQs below regarding relocation specials and, when you are ready to make your reservation, book online or call our friendly reservation agents. *Note that for some relocation specials, additional nights may be available at our regular rates.

Relocation specials are very limited in availability.

If you encounter any issues when trying to confirm your booking, please reach out to us via phone or email.
